notes: Identity independently established from the supplied text: title C-Reactive Protein Concentrations Diverge as a Function of Substance Use Disorder: A Pre-Registered Replication in a Clinical Sample; authors Jennifer L Stewart, Kaiping Burrows, April C May, Breanna A McNaughton, Ryan Smith, Rayus Kuplicki, Martin P Paulus and Leandra Figueroa-Hall; DOI 10.1016/j.drugalcdep.2024.111323; Drug Alcohol Dependence 260:111323 (2024). PMC author-manuscript full-text parse includes Methods, Results, Tables 1–3, Discussion and references; primary empirical report, not an abstract or secondary account. No PDF supplied. Only reported_success is assigned. The full supplied primary manuscript reports the positive BMI–CRP association and describes it as consistent with broader prior work, but gives no explicit replication-success verdict for the assigned BMI–CRP relationship against May et al. (2021). The explicit fully-replicated CRP verdict concerns the SUD group contrast, not the BMI coefficient. Significance is not used to infer author-reported success. Multiple BMI–CRP models are present (female omnibus, female post-hoc without SUD, male omnibus); no row-specific statistic selection was made. Explicit authors' verdict for the different SUD contrast: One out of the three biomarker findings fully replicated, wherein females with SUD exhibited lower CRP concentrations than females without SUD.
